title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang to testify before Congress

slides.headline: Nvidia's Jensen Huang to testify before Congress
slides.subtitle: Hearing set for December 1 regarding national security

slides.explanation: This involves the former leader of one of the world's most valuable technology companies. The scope of his testimony will likely impact global semiconductor policy.

slides.headline: Resignation followed allegations of an affair
slides.explanation: The hearing is happening because of his sudden exit after reports linked him to an alleged affair with a suspected Chinese spy.
Seven independent news outlets, including the Guardian and TechCrunch, have verified the details of this upcoming congressional hearing.

slides.subtitle: Read the full breakdown on Headlinne.

caption:
Jensen Huang, the former CEO of Nvidia, is scheduled to appear before several congressional committees on December 1.

The hearing aims to address a potential breach of national security.

This follows Huang's recent resignation from the company. Reports indicate his exit came after allegations of an affair with a suspected Chinese spy surfaced.

Because of Nvidia's central role in the global chip industry, lawmakers are treating this as a high-stakes investigation into sensitive technology and foreign influence.

story.title: Jensen Huang to testify before Congress on ‘potential breach of national security’
story.summary: High-stakes hearing comes in wake of resignation from Nvidia after alleged affair with suspected Chinese spy Nvidia’s former CEO Jensen Huang will testify before several congressional committees on 1 December, setting the stage for a high-stakes hearing in the wake of his resignation following an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. Tim Teter, Nvidia’s general counsel, has also agreed to appear for a closed-door transcribed interview the following day, 2 December. Continue reading...
